text: {"ops":[{"op":"add","content":"When an event’s schedule (date or time) changes, replace the existing record with the updated details rather than adding a duplicate item to memory.","weight":1.5},{"op":"add","content":"Automatically drop or flag items that are promotional newsletters, recruiter mail, or other low‑signal content unless a user explicitly marks them as important.","weight":1.5},{"op":"add","content":"Preserve any item with a pending deadline or scheduled follow‑up action even if it is older than three days; only remove items older than three days that have no deadline and no scheduled action.","weight":1.5}]}
